text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ――...What's up, LANE?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Can you solve this riddle? ♪ The trick to 
hide-and-seek is bowing your head twice!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. You just had to come up with 
another pain in the ass idea...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Next hint, trans~mitted♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I hope they're having fun. Now then, 
for the final photo—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Excuse me—wait, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for bumping into you. I was 
having so much fun that I wasn't paying 
attention to my surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad you asked♪ Actually, I'm 
inviting Shakur to play hide-and-seek 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And you know, it's not just ordinary 
hide-and-seek. I call it "Riddle 
Hide-and-Seek"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Right. Knowing Shakur, she wouldn't play 
a simple game of hide-and-seek with us, 
would she?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So, I thought of a riddle-solving 
hide-and-seek game where solving the 
riddle tells you where they're hiding♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I figured if it was a super difficult 
problem, Shakur would definitely take on 
the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you want to give it a try too, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Question! The secret to hide-and-seek is 
bowing your head twice. Find the answer's 
location from the three photos.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The first is the 'Mejiro Family Tea 
Party.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The second place is here, the "Library."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, send a photo from the 'Clubhouse 
Building' and the quiz is set! So, how 
about it? Think you can solve it?"
choice_data_list: I'd like a little more time to think.

I think I'd like a little more time to 
think.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it. In that case, try thinking 
about it while on the move♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after taking photos at the Club 
Building, we came to the shopping district 
with Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Wasn't the question 'The trick to 
hide-and-seek is to lower your head 
twice'?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The letters of the answer are hiding by 
ducking their heads twice. So to find 
them, we just have to raise their heads 
twice instead, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example, the first character of 
"Mejiro Tea Party" is "me." In the 
syllabary chart, two characters above "me" 
is "mi."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Two characters above 'To' in 
'Toshoshitsu' is 'Tsu'. Two characters 
above 'Bu' in 'Bushitsutou' is 'Ba'."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the correct answer is 'Mitsuba'! 
It's the name of a delicious ramen shop 
that Shakur and I go to all the time♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Too slow.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Shakur, you've solved the 
mystery already?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot, I didn't solve it. I just 
anticipated where you'd pick and got there 
first. Call it reading the meta."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I guess His High-and-Mightiness wanted to 
play at solving mysteries, huh...? Too bad 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: No, I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Deducing the answer without actually 
solving the problem is just like Shakur, 
always prioritizing efficiency. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The reason you could deduce that is 
because this shop holds memories for you 
too, right, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?!
choice_data_list: You two really are great friends.
You two really are great friends.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?!
choice_data_list: You two really are great friends.
You two really are great friends.

text_block_list.name: Fine & Shakur
text_block_list.text: "How so?!" "That's right♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have so many wonderful memories with 
Shakur at this shop♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You were the one who told me you could 
customize the order, too, Shakur!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why would I bother rememberin' trivial 
crap like that? ...Can I go home now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, Shakur. You have to eat your 
puzzle prize before you go!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As for me—let's see! No green onions, 
extra menma, and light on the oil, please♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. As soon as I'm done eating, I'm 
going home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur looks like she finds resisting 
to be more trouble than it's worth. She 
seems to maintain a comfortable distance 
while keeping Fine Motion company.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Hah, two idiots. You're a hundred years 
too early to beat me in a battle of wits.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you want, I can give you a quiz next 
time. Hope you can solve it before your 
Highness leaves Japan, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, challenge accepted! Together with 
Trainer, we'll solve it for sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why're both of you gangin' up on me so 
naturally? Man, can't let your guard down 
for a second around Her Royal Highness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu! Thanks for praising me, Shakur♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wasn't complimenting you," Air Shakur 
retorts, completely failing to phase Fine 
Motion. The two of them demonstrate an 
exquisite power balance.
